name: Unstructured Foundation
description:
Unstructured Foundation turns complex documents across your organization into clean, structured, searchable content for Claude. It processes virtually any document type—including PDFs, scans, images, presentations, spreadsheets, tables, and complex layouts—using OCR, image understanding, and table extraction to unlock information that is normally trapped inside messy files.

Claude can then search and retrieve processed document text, titles, summaries, topics, and entities; summarize findings; compare information across files; and analyze trends across an up-to-date organizational knowledge layer. Use Foundation to ask questions across reports, decks, spreadsheets, contracts, research, and operational documents, with answers grounded in the supporting source documents.

Connect content from many sources, including Google Drive, Dropbox, and Slack, then let Foundation keep it searchable as documents are added or changed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unstructured Foundation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unstructured Foundation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.foundation.unstructured.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unstructured Foundation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unstructured Foundation provides these MCP tools: asset_get_artifact, asset_get_doc_text, asset_query, describe_corpus, pipeline_link_source, pipeline_list_sources, pipeline_manage_sources, pipeline_process_source, and pipeline_processing_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unstructured Foundation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Unstructured Foundation in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Unstructured Foundation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unstructured Foundation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unstructured Foundation is developed by Unstructured. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
